data.one_liner: Integrate PayPal payments into your Flutter mobile, web, and desktop application.
data.what_it_does: Simplifies PayPal integration by providing an in-app checkout view supporting both sandbox and production environments. It offers callbacks for payment success, errors, and cancellations alongside customizable transaction details.
use_when: You need to accept PayPal payments in your Flutter app.
You want to test payments using PayPal sandbox mode.
avoid_when: You require payment gateways other than PayPal.
You need complex subscription management not supported by the package.
strengths: Provides success, error, and cancellation callbacks
weaknesses: Not documented for advanced subscription and recurring payment setups yet
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and configure your PayPal client ID and secret key.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you want to integrate Stripe payments instead of PayPal.

data.minimal_example: Navigator.of(context).push(MaterialPageRoute(builder: (BuildContext context) => PaypalCheckoutView(sandboxMode: true, clientId: "", secretKey: "", transactions: const [], onSuccess: (Map params) async {}, onError: (error) {}, onCancel: () {})));
